summary: Concentrated: 66 holdings, but the top ten are 62% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 76% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 3.0 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable, faster-growing and much larger.
Big sector bet: 36% in Information Technology.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 6 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in Belgium in 1967; computer science at MIT, then McKinsey and Tiger Management (from 1996), where he covered telecoms and technology. Founded Coatue in 1999, one of the 'Tiger Cubs' who learned under Julian Robertson.
profile.approach: Technology, media and telecoms, in both listed shares and private companies.
known: Has backed listed companies such as Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC, and private ones such as ByteDance, DoorDash and OpenAI.
profile.note: Coatue's private investments are not in the 13F.
